OAuth2.description: Cora Workspace OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code Flow

scopes.workspace:read: View workspace profile, team members, status metrics, and intake forms.
scopes.workspace:write: Update workspace branding, business profile, and platform settings.
scopes.canvas:read: Inspect active themes, landing page templates, route maps, and source HTML.
scopes.canvas:write: Create themes, edit page markup, and publish landing page code live instantly.
scopes.leads:read: Access incoming client inquiries, deal values, and funnel pipeline stages.
scopes.leads:write: Create new leads, update deal values, advance funnel stages, and log notes.
scopes.clients:read: Read client accounts, contact profiles, and historical interactions.
scopes.clients:write: Create, update, and manage client records and preferences.
scopes.projects:read: Read shoot schedules, booking packages, deliverables, and event milestones.
scopes.projects:write: Schedule bookings, assign shoot crews, update package amounts, and track delivery.
scopes.tasks:read: Read workspace task boards, assignments, priorities, and deadlines.
scopes.tasks:write: Create, assign, prioritize, update, and move tasks across Kanban stages.
scopes.finance:read: Read revenue metrics, client invoices, outstanding receivables, and ledgers.
scopes.finance:write: Create invoices, record client payments, and track expense transactions.
scopes.content:read: Search editorial articles, guides, knowledge documents, and SEO metrics.
scopes.content:write: Create structured articles/guides, optimize keywords, and publish live.
scopes.knowledge:read: Semantic query across living memory, past shoots, SOPs, and intelligence.
scopes.knowledge:write: Store new context fragments, client preferences, and operational memory.
scopes.workflows:read: Inspect automated rule configurations, triggers, and notification flows.
scopes.workflows:write: Configure and trigger automated actions, webhooks, and alerts.
